balance_units.description: Units in which remaining_balance is expressed. A single entry means the provider always uses that unit; multiple entries mean the unit is account-specific and returned per Permit at runtime. EURO balances may be stored in cents depending on the provider.

reservation_target_selection.description: How start_reservation lets the caller choose a reservation target. "list": only ids from list_reservation_targets() are accepted. "free_input": the provider also accepts other ids it can resolve itself. When omitted, the provider has no target choice and rejects a reservation_target_id.
